title: Suspicious Windows process activity on managed endpoint
description: SOC alert: unusual process creation activity was reported on a Windows endpoint. Endpoint telemetry is collected into Splunk via Sysmon (index=sysmon, sourcetype XmlWinEventLog). The alert summary alone is insufficient — SIEM evidence is required to validate process creation chains, parent/child relationships, users, and command lines.
investigation_objective: Use Splunk SIEM evidence to investigate Windows Sysmon process creation activity during the last 60 minutes. Determine whether suspicious process execution occurred on the affected endpoint by querying relevant Sysmon telemetry (process creation events) before concluding. Do not rely on the alert narrative alone.

telemetry.note: Endpoint Sysmon data available in Splunk SIEM
